title: Assets: Scoped Bitbucket repository selection
description:
Assets is improving how you manage Bitbucket repositories by introducing workspace-scoped selection. This change ensures that repository searches and selections are faster and more reliable by focusing on specific Bitbucket workspaces. Go to Assets in Jira Service Management.
	Select an object schema, then select an object type that uses the Bitbucket repository attribute or create a new Bitbucket repository attribute.
